name: Gōdo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Gōdo town emblem in purple and white: a purple disc bearing the character 神 in white.
history: Municipal flag of Gōdo, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 23 December 1963.

features.role: Gōdo town emblem — a purple disc bearing the character 神 in white
